title: Chapter 243: Four-Star Trial Mission
html:
After dragging Zhu Xiu from the elevator, Chen Ge did not leave. He stepped back inside, with Zhang Ya following close behind, apparently unwilling to leave his side. “Since you’re already out, why don’t we go cause some chaos?”

Chen Ge glanced back at her. The Red Specter seemed to have grown stronger. Her dress, apparently woven from crimson threads, now looked almost real. Zhang Ya kept her head bowed and stayed close, her drifting hair occasionally brushing Chen Ge’s arm. Tendrils resembling blood vessels extended from beneath her dress, poised as though ready to burrow into his body.

The sight was terrifying. Chen Ge had not expected Zhang Ya to change so dramatically. In fact, while he held Zhu Xiu’s mouth shut, the black phone had issued an alert: her affection had advanced beyond Gripped by Passion and was approaching the next stage.

Like water spilling from an overfilled vase, every small gesture betrayed Zhang Ya’s overflowing affection. Do you like ghosts? If not, I’ll turn everyone you love into one—including you.

The bloody tendrils and black hair gently coiled around Chen Ge, chilling him to the core. When he looked back, Zhang Ya feigned innocence and merely continued following him.

I can feel the murderous intent. I need to distract her somehow.

Chen Ge selected the twenty-third floor, intending to return to the twenty-fourth. He did not truly wish to act so recklessly, but one problem had occurred to him.

Normally, Zhang Ya would return to his shadow on her own, but this time, it did not seem like Zhang Ya had any interest in returning!

If he did not give Zhang Ya something to occupy her, he feared he might become her next target. Love and hatred were equally extreme emotions. The way she watched him was unnerving, as though she were considering turning him into a doll too. Then they could remain together forever.

The doors slowly closed, and the hair rose along Chen Ge’s neck. He suddenly longed to return to the room full of society members; among them, he had felt safer. Reaching the twenty-fourth floor required repeating the ritual. Chen Ge retreated into a corner and, while Zhang Ya was not looking, took out the black phone.

“Resolving her last wish, Zhang Ya’s affection level has reached Gripped by Passion!

“Specter’s Favored, congratulations for completing Zhang Ya’s Bloody Heart Mission with a hundred percent completion rate!

“Reward Option One: Unlock the three-star scenario Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy! It contains seven mini-scenarios: White Valentines, Red Dancing Shoes, Cursed Love Letter, Girls’ Dormitory, Crying Chairs, the Hanging Man, and the Stink!

“Warning: After you select this reward, Zhang Ya, the Red Specter, will be confined to the scenario!

“Reward Option Two: Remove every scenario related to Zhang Ya, leaving only the Hanging Man and the Stink. Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy will be downgraded to two stars, but Zhang Ya’s movements will remain unrestricted!”

The message surprised Chen Ge. He did not expect that Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy would be a three-star scenario and Zhang Ya would be related to five mini scenarios!

The Third Sick Hall had likely earned its three-star rating through the ten patients and the creatures behind the door. Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy, by contrast, reached three stars through Zhang Ya alone.

She’s scarier than I thought!

After devouring several creatures and much of the old director in the Third Sick Hall, Zhang Ya had grown stronger. Her malice had intensified, and her dress glowed a brighter red.

If I pick the first reward, I’ll get a complete three-star scenario, but I’ll lose Zhang Ya’s aid whenever I’m out of the Haunted House.

Chen Ge stole another glance at Zhang Ya. After careful thought, he selected the second reward. He could not deny the possibility that choosing the first might prevent him from leaving the elevator alive. More importantly, he believed he was the only person Zhang Ya could rely upon. After all she had suffered, he wanted to offer her whatever warmth he could. He selected the second option, and a new message appeared.

“Are you sure you want to select Reward Number Two?”

“Yes.”

“Congratulations on unlocking the two-star scenario Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy! Because this scenario is a reward for completing the Bloody Heart Mission, it contains no hidden missions or safety hazards!”

No security threats? Meaning I can allow my visitors to explore the place to their hearts’ content?

If the black phone guaranteed it, the scenario should be safe. Chen Ge was pleased to have received a two-star attraction without cost. Then another message appeared.

“Specter’s Favored, congratulations for completing Zhang Ya’s Bloody Heart Mission with a hundred percent completion rate! Successfully triggered the Trial Mission for four-star scenario—School of the Afterlife!

“Warning: Four-star scenarios are extremely dangerous! The School of the Afterlife Trial Mission consists of eight Side Missions and one Final Mission. The completion period is three months.

“You have completed seven Side Missions at Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy and Mu Yang High School. Complete the eighth Side Mission, Eternal Life, to unlock the Final Mission!

“Side Mission 8: Eternal Life (In an undisclosed underground morgue, a group seeks eternal life). Mission Location: Jiujiang Medical University.

“Final Mission: Currently locked.”

After reading, Chen Ge pocketed the phone. Each additional star doubled or tripled a scenario’s difficulty. During the Third Sick Hall Trial Mission, the thin monster would have killed him had he faced it alone. Without Zhang Ya’s help, he would never have entered the bloodred door.

Viewed another way, Zhang Ya alone had made Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy a three-star scenario. Her power was equivalent to the terror of an entire attraction at that level.

I should ignore the four-star mission for now. Three-star missions already involve Red Specters, so a four-star scenario must contain something worse.

Chen Ge tried to understand that world, but the more he found out, the more confused he became.

I have three months to clear School of the Afterlife. There is still time. My immediate concern is dealing with the Ghost Stories Society and completing the Third Sick Hall’s hidden mission.

Chen Ge followed the introduction on the flyer and returned to the 24th floor, but this time, he did not enter alone.
